signals.title_en: Novartis's chief executive says AI will not cure cancer in five to ten years; expects about four years off drug development after a decade

signals.so_what_en: A large pharma buyer of AI tools, whose chief executive also sits on Anthropic's board, puts the gain at a shorter timeline rather than cures, and says human and animal testing stays the bottleneck; it is a statement of expectation, not a result.
signals.so_what_zh: 一家大量采购 AI 工具的大型药企（其首席执行官同时是 Anthropic 董事）认为 AI 的收益是缩短研发周期而非治愈疾病，动物和人体试验仍是瓶颈；这是预期表态，不是试验结果。
signals.changes_view_en: Changes my view if Novartis or another large pharma reports a measured rise in clinical success rates for AI-assisted programmes.
signals.changes_view_zh: 如果诺华或其他大型药企公布 AI 辅助项目临床成功率的实测提升，我会改变看法。

signals.so_what_en: Enrolment is finished for this Exscientia-origin drug, so the next event is data; the registry gives January 2028 for primary completion.

signals.changes_view_en: the trial is terminated, or results are posted earlier than the registry date.

signals.so_what_en: A relabelling in the registry of a very small exploratory study; it says nothing about whether the drug works.
signals.so_what_zh: 登记库对一项很小的探索性研究做了分期调整，并不说明药物是否有效。
signals.changes_view_en: the study is withdrawn or a full Phase 1 is registered.

signals.so_what_en: Another large drugmaker pays for Isomorphic's platform, but without the upfront figure the deal cannot be sized or compared with earlier ones.

signals.title_en: Recursion says the FDA agreed the design of a registrational Phase 3 trial for REC-4881
signals.title_zh: Recursion 称 FDA 已同意 REC-4881 注册性三期试验的设计
signals.so_what_en: A randomised, placebo-controlled trial of about 200 patients, due to start in the second half of 2027, would be one of the first late-stage tests of a drug from an AI drug company; the supporting data so far are from an uncontrolled Phase 1b/2 study.
signals.so_what_zh: 这项约 200 名患者的随机、安慰剂对照试验计划于 2027 年下半年启动，将是 AI 制药公司药物最早的后期检验之一；目前的支持数据来自无对照的 1b/2 期研究。
signals.changes_view_en: the trial start slips past 2027, or the FDA's position on the endpoint changes.
signals.changes_view_zh: 试验启动推迟到 2027 年之后，或 FDA 对终点的立场发生变化。

signals.title_zh: Isomorphic Labs 完成 50 亿美元 C 轮融资，由 Greenoaks 和红杉领投
signals.so_what_en: US$5B a few months after a US$2.1B round, with no drug yet in human trials: a reading of private appetite and a comparable for listed AI drug platforms, not evidence that the science works.
signals.so_what_zh: 在 21 亿美元融资数月之后再融 50 亿美元，而尚无药物进入人体试验：这反映的是私募市场的热度，可作为上市 AI 药物平台的可比参照，并不证明科学有效。

signals.changes_view_zh: Isomorphic 或其合作方将其候选药物推进人体试验。

profile.name: Recursion
profile.what_en: Recursion uses AI and automated lab experiments to find and develop its own drugs. It has no product on sale; revenue comes mainly from research collaborations with drug makers such as Sanofi and Roche/Genentech.
profile.what_zh: Recursion 用 AI 和自动化实验室寻找并开发自有药物。公司尚无产品上市，收入主要来自与赛诺菲、罗氏/基因泰克等药企的研发合作。
profile.ai_en: Its platform, Recursion OS, covers drug discovery through development; it merged with the UK AI drug designer Exscientia in November 2024.
profile.ai_zh: 其平台 Recursion OS 覆盖从药物发现到开发的全过程；2024 年 11 月与英国 AI 药物设计公司 Exscientia 合并。
profile.lead_en: As of November 2026: REC-4881 for familial adenomatous polyposis (inherited bowel polyps) is in a Phase 1b/2 trial. On 18 November 2026 Recursion said the FDA agreed its Phase 3 design (about 200 patients); start planned for second-half 2027.
profile.lead_zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月：REC-4881 用于家族性腺瘤性息肉病（一种导致肠道多发息肉的遗传病），处于 1b/2 期试验。公司 2026 年 11 月 18 日称 FDA 已同意三期试验设计（约 200 名患者），计划 2027 年下半年启动。

source.title: Recursion Announces Alignment with FDA on Registrational Phase 3 Trial Design for REC-4881 in Familial Adenomatous Polyposis

profile.name: Insilico Medicine
profile.what_en: Insilico Medicine designs drug candidates with its own AI software and develops them itself or licenses them to larger drug makers. It reported a net profit of about $35.5 million for the first half of 2026.
profile.what_zh: 英矽智能用自研 AI 软件设计候选药物，自行开发或授权给大型药企。公司披露 2026 年上半年净利润约 0.36 亿美元。
profile.ai_en: Its platform is called Pharma.AI; in March 2026 it signed a collaboration with Eli Lilly worth up to $2.75 billion including milestones.
profile.ai_zh: 其平台名为 Pharma.AI；2026 年 3 月与礼来签署合作协议，含里程碑付款最高 27.5 亿美元。
profile.lead_en: As of November 2026: rentosertib (INS018_055), a pill for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (scarring of the lungs), is in a Phase 3 trial in China that started in July 2026 and plans to enrol 320 patients.
profile.lead_zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月：rentosertib（INS018_055）是治疗特发性肺纤维化（肺部瘢痕化）的口服药，三期试验已于 2026 年 7 月在中国启动，计划入组 320 名患者。

source.title: Insilico Initiates Phase III Clinical Trial for Rentosertib, Its AI-Empowered TNIK Inhibitor for Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis

profile.name: Generate Biomedicines
profile.what_en: Generate Biomedicines designs protein drugs, mainly antibodies, with machine-learning models and develops them itself. It has no product on sale; revenue comes from research programmes with Amgen and Novartis.
profile.what_zh: Generate Biomedicines 用机器学习模型设计蛋白质药物（主要是抗体）并自行开发。公司尚无产品上市，收入来自与安进、诺华的研究项目。
profile.ai_en: It calls its approach generative biology: models propose new protein sequences that its labs then test; partners include Novartis, Amgen and, since October 2026, Zealand Pharma.
profile.ai_zh: 公司称其方法为“生成式生物学”：由模型提出新的蛋白质序列，再由实验室验证；合作方包括诺华、安进，以及 2026 年 10 月起的 Zealand Pharma。
profile.lead_en: As of November 2026: GB-0895, an antibody against TSLP designed for dosing twice a year, is in two global Phase 3 trials (SOLAIRIA-1 and SOLAIRIA-2) in severe asthma.
profile.lead_zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月：GB-0895 是一种抗 TSLP 抗体，设计为每年给药两次，正在重度哮喘中进行两项全球三期试验（SOLAIRIA-1 和 SOLAIRIA-2）。

source.title: Generate Biomedicines Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Business Update

profile.name: Schrödinger
profile.what_en: Schrödinger sells software that simulates how molecules behave, used by drug and materials companies. It also earns fees, milestones and royalties from drug discovery collaborations and holds stakes in companies it helped start.
profile.what_zh: 薛定谔销售模拟分子行为的软件，客户为药企和材料企业；公司还从药物发现合作中获得服务费、里程碑付款和特许权使用费，并持有其参与创办公司的股权。
profile.ai_en: Its platform combines physics-based simulation with machine learning; partners include Novartis, and it co-invented zasocitinib, now owned by Takeda and under FDA review.
profile.ai_zh: 其平台把基于物理的模拟与机器学习结合；合作方包括诺华，公司还是 zasocitinib 的共同发明方，该药现归武田所有，正在接受 FDA 审评。
profile.lead_en: As of November 2026: SGR-1505, a MALT1 inhibitor for B-cell blood cancers, is in Phase 1; updated data are due at a haematology meeting in December 2026.
profile.lead_zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月：SGR-1505 是一种 MALT1 抑制剂，用于 B 细胞血液肿瘤，处于一期试验；更新数据将于 2026 年 12 月在血液学会议上公布。

source.title: Schrödinger Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

profile.name: Absci
profile.what_en: Absci designs antibody drugs with generative AI models and tests them in its own labs. It develops some itself and designs others for partners; revenue is small ($0.3 million in the third quarter of 2026).
profile.what_zh: Absci 用生成式 AI 模型设计抗体药物，并在自有实验室验证；部分自行开发，部分为合作方设计。收入规模很小（2026 年第三季度为 30 万美元）。
profile.ai_en: Its Integrated Drug Creation platform pairs AI models with a synthetic-biology lab that generates the training data.
profile.ai_zh: 其 Integrated Drug Creation 平台把 AI 模型与产生训练数据的合成生物学实验室结合。
profile.lead_en: As of November 2026: ABS-201, an antibody for pattern hair loss, is in a Phase 1/2a trial; 13-week interim data are expected in December 2026 and full data in early 2027.
profile.lead_zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月：ABS-201 是治疗雄激素性脱发的抗体，处于 1/2a 期试验；预计 2026 年 12 月公布 13 周中期数据，2027 年初公布完整数据。

source.title: Absci Reports Business Updates and Third Quarter 2026 Financial and Operating Results

profile.name: AbCellera
profile.what_en: AbCellera discovers antibody drugs. It began by finding antibodies for partners in return for research fees and royalties, and now also develops its own; third-quarter 2026 revenue was $10.6 million, mostly research fees.
profile.what_zh: AbCellera 从事抗体药物发现。公司最初为合作方寻找抗体并收取研究费用和特许权使用费，现在也开发自有药物；2026 年第三季度收入 1060 万美元，主要为研究费用。
profile.ai_en: Its link to AI is indirect: it describes a discovery engine built on single-cell screening and high-throughput testing, and its November 2026 results release does not mention AI.
profile.ai_zh: 它与 AI 的关联是间接的：公司介绍的发现平台以单细胞筛选和高通量检测为基础，2026 年 11 月的业绩公告未提及 AI。
profile.lead_en: As of November 2026: ABCL635, an injected antibody for menopausal hot flashes, reported positive top-line Phase 2 results; the company expects to start late-stage trials in 2027.
profile.lead_zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月：ABCL635 是治疗更年期潮热的注射用抗体，已公布积极的二期顶线结果；公司预计 2027 年启动后期试验。

source.title: AbCellera Reports Q3 2026 Business Results

profile.name: Relay Therapeutics
profile.what_en: Relay Therapeutics develops pills for cancer and genetic diseases. It sells no product itself; its income is licence revenue, and the first drug from its platform, lirafugratinib, was approved in the US in 2026 and is sold by licensee Elevar Therapeutics.
profile.what_zh: Relay Therapeutics 开发治疗癌症和遗传病的口服药。公司自身没有在售产品，收入为授权收入；其平台产出的首个药物 lirafugratinib 于 2026 年在美国获批，由被授权方 Elevar Therapeutics 销售。
profile.ai_en: Its Dynamo platform combines computer simulation of how proteins move with lab experiments to design small-molecule drugs.
profile.ai_zh: 其 Dynamo 平台把蛋白质运动的计算机模拟与实验结合，用于设计小分子药物。
profile.lead_en: As of November 2026: zovegalisib (RLY-2608) is in a Phase 3 trial (ReDiscover-2) in HR+/HER2- metastatic breast cancer with a PI3Kα mutation, compared against capivasertib, both given with fulvestrant.
profile.lead_zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月：zovegalisib（RLY-2608）正在携带 PI3Kα 突变的 HR+/HER2- 转移性乳腺癌中进行三期试验（ReDiscover-2），与 capivasertib 对照，两者均联用氟维司群。

source.title: Relay Therapeutics Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Corporate Updates

profile.name: Iambic Therapeutics
profile.what_en: Iambic Therapeutics designs small-molecule cancer drugs with AI and develops them itself; it also has discovery partnerships with drug makers including Takeda, AbbVie, Jazz and Revolution Medicines. It raised $150 million in its October 2026 listing.
profile.what_zh: Iambic Therapeutics 用 AI 设计小分子抗癌药并自行开发，同时与武田、艾伯维、Jazz、Revolution Medicines 等药企开展药物发现合作。公司 2026 年 10 月上市，募资 1.5 亿美元。
profile.ai_en: Its AI models include Enchant, which predicts how a drug candidate will behave in the body, and NeuralPLexer, which predicts molecular structures.
profile.ai_zh: 其 AI 模型包括预测候选药物体内表现的 Enchant 和预测分子结构的 NeuralPLexer。
profile.lead_en: As of November 2026: IAM1363, a pill that blocks HER2 for HER2-altered solid tumours including breast and lung cancers, is in a Phase 1/1b trial; a registrational trial could start as soon as 2027.
profile.lead_zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月：IAM1363 是一种口服 HER2 抑制剂，用于乳腺癌、肺癌等 HER2 异常实体瘤，处于 1/1b 期试验；注册性试验最早可能于 2027 年启动。

source.title: Iambic, an AI drug discovery specialist, banks $150M in an IPO

profile.name: Tempus AI

profile.what_zh: Tempus 销售基因组等实验室检测（主要用于癌症），并把由此形成的去标识化患者数据和模型授权给药企。2026 年第三季度收入 4.115 亿美元，其中诊断 3.035 亿美元，数据与应用 1.081 亿美元。
profile.ai_en: Drug makers use its data and models in R&D; in October 2026 Bristol Myers Squibb agreed to license oncology data and models for up to $137.5 million over five years.
profile.ai_zh: 药企在研发中使用其数据和模型；2026 年 10 月，百时美施贵宝同意在五年内以最高 1.375 亿美元授权使用其肿瘤数据和模型。

source.title: Tempus Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

profile.name: XtalPi
profile.what_en: XtalPi sells drug-discovery and materials-research services that combine AI, physics-based calculation and robot-run laboratories. First-half 2026 revenue was RMB 393.6 million, about half from drug discovery work and half from automated-lab and AI solutions.
profile.what_zh: 晶泰科技提供结合 AI、物理计算和机器人实验室的药物发现与材料研发服务。2026 年上半年收入 3.936 亿元人民币，药物发现服务与自动化实验室及 AI 解决方案约各占一半。
profile.ai_en: It designs drug candidates for partners rather than running its own trials; its largest deal, with DoveTree in 2025, is worth up to about $6 billion in milestones, of which $51 million was paid first.
profile.ai_zh: 公司为合作方设计候选药物，而不是自己开展临床试验；最大一笔合作是 2025 年与 DoveTree 的协议，含里程碑付款最高约 60 亿美元，首笔已付 0.51 亿美元。

source.publisher: XtalPi (press release via Thailand Business News)
source.title: XtalPi Holdings Announces 2026 Interim Results

profile.name: Thermo Fisher Scientific
profile.what_en: Thermo Fisher sells laboratory instruments, chemicals and supplies, and runs clinical trials (PPD) and drug manufacturing (Patheon) for drug makers. Annual revenue is over $40 billion.
profile.what_zh: 赛默飞销售实验室仪器、试剂和耗材，并为药企提供临床试验（PPD）和药品生产（Patheon）服务。年收入超过 400 亿美元。
profile.ai_en: AI is a small part of the business: it is building AI into instruments and trial services, with OpenAI (announced October 2025, starting in clinical trials) and with NVIDIA (January 2026, for laboratory instruments and automation).
profile.ai_zh: AI 只占业务的一小部分：公司正把 AI 嵌入仪器和临床试验服务，合作方包括 OpenAI（2025 年 10 月宣布，先用于临床试验）和英伟达（2026 年 1 月，用于实验室仪器和自动化）。

profile.name: Lantern Pharma
profile.what_en: Lantern Pharma is a small cancer-drug developer that uses AI to pick which patients and cancers its drugs may suit. It reported no revenue in 2026 to date; its chief executive resigned on 15 November 2026 and the finance chief is interim CEO.
profile.what_zh: Lantern Pharma 是一家小型抗癌药开发公司，用 AI 判断其药物可能适合哪些患者和癌种。公司 2026 年至今没有收入；首席执行官已于 2026 年 11 月 15 日辞职，由首席财务官暂代。
profile.ai_en: Its AI platform, RADR, is described as using more than 200 billion cancer-related data points and over 200 algorithms.
profile.ai_zh: 其 AI 平台 RADR 据称使用超过 2000 亿个癌症相关数据点和 200 多种算法。
profile.lead_en: As of November 2026: LP-300 is in a Phase 2 trial (HARMONIC) in lung cancer patients who have never smoked, given with chemotherapy; the second part of the trial opened in Taiwan in 2026.
profile.lead_zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月：LP-300 正在从不吸烟的肺癌患者中进行二期试验（HARMONIC），与化疗联用；试验第二部分已于 2026 年在台湾启动。

source.title: Lantern Pharma Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Business Updates

profile.name: Evaxion
profile.what_en: Evaxion is a small Danish company that uses AI to design vaccines, now mainly against cancer. It has no product on sale and recorded no revenue in the third quarter of 2026; earlier revenue came from licensing a vaccine candidate to MSD.
profile.what_zh: Evaxion 是一家丹麦小型公司，用 AI 设计疫苗，目前以癌症疫苗为主。公司没有在售产品，2026 年第三季度没有收入；此前的收入来自向默沙东授权一款候选疫苗。
profile.ai_en: Its platform, AI-Immunology, is used to pick vaccine targets and design candidates; in November 2026 it said it would focus on cancer and pursue infectious-disease work only with partner funding.
profile.ai_zh: 其平台 AI-Immunology 用于挑选疫苗靶点和设计候选产品；2026 年 11 月公司表示将聚焦癌症，传染病项目仅在合作方出资时推进。
profile.lead_en: As of November 2026: EVX-01, a cancer vaccine made individually for each patient, has completed a Phase 2 trial in advanced melanoma (with pembrolizumab); the company is seeking partners to take it further.
profile.lead_zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月：EVX-01 是为每位患者单独制备的癌症疫苗，已完成晚期黑色素瘤二期试验（联用帕博利珠单抗）；公司正在寻找合作方继续推进。

source.title: Evaxion announces strategy and business update and third quarter 2026 financial results

profile.name: BioAge Labs
profile.what_en: BioAge develops drugs for heart and metabolic diseases by studying the biology of human ageing. It has no product on sale and funds itself from investors and research collaborations with Novartis and Lilly.
profile.what_zh: BioAge 通过研究人类衰老的生物学机制，开发心血管和代谢疾病药物。公司没有在售产品，资金来自投资者以及与诺华、礼来的研究合作。
profile.ai_en: Its target-discovery platform analyses human longevity data, and it has an AI-driven drug discovery collaboration with Deep Origin; the company does not describe itself mainly as an AI company.
profile.ai_zh: 其靶点发现平台分析人类长寿数据，并与 Deep Origin 开展 AI 驱动的药物发现合作；公司并不主要以 AI 公司自居。
profile.lead_en: As of November 2026: BGE-102, a pill that blocks NLRP3 (a driver of inflammation), is in two Phase 2 trials: obesity with cardiovascular risk (data expected in late 2026) and diabetic macular edema. An earlier drug, azelaprag, was stopped over liver findings.
profile.lead_zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月：BGE-102 是一种口服 NLRP3（炎症驱动因子）抑制剂，正在进行两项二期试验：伴心血管风险的肥胖（预计 2026 年第四季度出数据）和糖尿病黄斑水肿。此前的药物 azelaprag 因肝脏指标异常而停止。

source.title: BioAge Labs Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Business Updates

profile.name: Structure Therapeutics
profile.what_en: Structure Therapeutics develops pills for obesity and related metabolic diseases, aiming to offer oral alternatives to injected drugs. It has no product on sale and funds its trials from investors; cash was about $1.2 billion in September 2026.
profile.what_zh: Structure Therapeutics 开发治疗肥胖及相关代谢疾病的口服药，目标是替代注射药物。公司没有在售产品，试验资金来自投资者；2026 年 9 月底现金约 12 亿美元。
profile.ai_en: It designs molecules from the 3D structure of their protein targets by computer (structure-based design) and was co-founded by Schrödinger; its own releases do not use the term AI.
profile.ai_zh: 公司依据靶点蛋白的三维结构用计算机设计分子（基于结构的药物设计），由薛定谔参与创办；其公告并未使用“AI”一词。
profile.lead_en: As of November 2026: aleniglipron, a once-daily GLP-1 pill for weight management, is in two Phase 3 trials (ACCOMPLISH-1 and ACCOMPLISH-2) that started in August 2026; first results are expected in the second half of 2028.
profile.lead_zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月：aleniglipron 是每日一次的口服 GLP-1 减重药，两项三期试验（ACCOMPLISH-1 和 ACCOMPLISH-2）已于 2026 年 8 月启动，预计 2028 年下半年公布首批结果。

source.title: Structure Therapeutics Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Recent Highlights

profile.name: Compugen

profile.what_en: Compugen finds new targets for cancer immunotherapy by computer and develops antibodies against them. Its revenue comes from licence payments: AstraZeneca and Gilead each develop a drug based on its discoveries.
profile.what_zh: Compugen 用计算方法寻找癌症免疫治疗的新靶点，并开发相应抗体。收入来自授权付款：阿斯利康和吉利德各自在开发一款基于其发现的药物。
profile.ai_en: Its computational discovery platform, Unigen, which the company describes as AI-powered, identified the targets TIGIT, PVRIG and IL-18BP.
profile.ai_zh: 其计算发现平台 Unigen（公司称由 AI 驱动）发现了 TIGIT、PVRIG 和 IL-18BP 等靶点。

profile.lead_zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月：自有主要项目 COM701 正在卵巢癌中进行安慰剂对照试验（已入组 62 名患者，预计 2027 年 3 月底前出结果）。使用 Compugen 抗体成分的 rilvegostomig 由阿斯利康开展三期试验。

profile.name: Alphabet
profile.what_en: Alphabet is the parent of Google; most of its revenue comes from advertising on Search and YouTube and from Google Cloud. It is also the parent of the AI lab Google DeepMind and the main backer of Isomorphic Labs.
profile.what_zh: Alphabet 是谷歌的母公司，收入主要来自搜索和 YouTube 广告以及谷歌云。它也是 AI 实验室 Google DeepMind 的母公司，并是 Isomorphic Labs 的主要出资方。
profile.ai_en: Drug discovery is a small part of the business: Isomorphic Labs (founded 2021, London) designs drugs with its IsoDDE engine for partners Lilly, Novartis, Johnson & Johnson and, since November 2026, Merck; it raised $2.1 billion in May 2026.
profile.ai_zh: 药物发现只占业务的一小部分：Isomorphic Labs（2021 年成立，总部伦敦）用其 IsoDDE 引擎为礼来、诺华、强生以及 2026 年 11 月起的默沙东设计药物；2026 年 5 月融资 21 亿美元。

source.title: Isomorphic Labs press release on its $2.1 billion Series B funding (12 May 2026)

glossary.def_en: Human trials run in stages. Phase 1 tests safety in a few people; Phase 2 is the first real test of whether the drug works, and where most fail; Phase 3 confirms it in hundreds or thousands before approval. "Phase 1/2" combines two stages in one trial.
glossary.def_zh: 人体试验分阶段进行。一期在少数人身上测试安全性；二期首次真正检验药物是否有效，多数药物在此失败；三期在数百至数千人中确证疗效，之后才能申请上市。“1/2 期”指一项试验合并两个阶段。

glossary.def_en: The date the sponsor expects to have collected the data for the trial's main question. Results usually follow within months. It is the sponsor's own estimate and often slips.
glossary.def_zh: 申办方预计收齐试验主要问题所需数据的日期，结果通常在其后数月内公布。这是申办方自己的估计，经常推迟。

glossary.def_en: Patients are assigned by chance to the drug or to a comparison (placebo or standard care). Without this, an apparent benefit may be chance or patient selection.
glossary.def_zh: 患者被随机分配到试验药物组或对照组（安慰剂或标准治疗）。没有随机对照，看到的疗效可能只是偶然或选人造成的。

glossary.def_en: Recruiting: enrolling patients. Active, not recruiting: enrolment closed, patients still being followed. Completed: finished, which does not mean it succeeded. Terminated, withdrawn or suspended: stopped early.
glossary.def_zh: 招募中：正在入组。进行中但不再招募：入组结束，仍在随访。已完成：试验结束，但不代表成功。终止、撤回或暂停：提前停止。

glossary.def_en: A trial the sponsor ended, withdrew or paused before completion. The reason shown is the sponsor's own wording in the registry.
glossary.def_zh: 申办方在完成前终止、撤回或暂停的试验。所示原因为申办方在登记库中的原话。

glossary.def_en: Cash the drugmaker pays when the deal is signed. It is the only part of a deal's value that is certain.
glossary.def_zh: 药企在签约时支付的现金，是交易金额中唯一确定的部分。

glossary.def_en: The "up to" figure in a deal announcement: upfront plus every milestone payment if all the drugs succeed. Most of it is rarely paid.
glossary.def_zh: 交易公告中的“最高可达”金额：首付款加上所有药物都成功时的全部里程碑付款。其中大部分很少真正支付。

glossary.def_en: 0 to 3: how much an item shows the science works. 0 is a claim or money only; 3 needs a randomised human trial result or a regulator's decision. Funding always scores 0.
glossary.def_zh: 0 到 3 分：该条目在多大程度上说明科学有效。0 分只是说法或资金；3 分需要随机人体试验结果或监管决定。融资恒为 0 分。

glossary.def_en: 0 to 3: how much money is moving. 2 means it changes estimates or deal comparisons for a listed company; 3 means it is likely to move a share price or sector spending. It is a description, not a recommendation.
glossary.def_zh: 0 到 3 分：资金变动的程度。2 分表示会改变某上市公司的预期或交易参照；3 分表示可能推动股价或行业支出。这是描述，不是建议。

glossary.def_en: A company touched indirectly: a supplier of computing power or lab tools, a research contractor, or the listed parent of a private company.
glossary.def_zh: 间接受影响的公司：算力或实验室工具供应商、研究外包商，或未上市公司的上市母公司。

glossary.def_en: A company that describes its drug-discovery platform as AI or machine learning. Judged by company, not by molecule; companies using physics-based computation are listed separately as contested.
glossary.def_zh: 自称其药物发现平台由 AI 或机器学习驱动的公司。按公司而非分子判断；以物理计算为主的公司单列为“有争议”。

glossary.def_en: Share price divided by the last twelve months' earnings per share. Not shown for loss-making companies, which includes most drug developers.
glossary.def_zh: 股价除以过去十二个月的每股收益。亏损公司不显示，大多数药物研发公司属于此类。

glossary.def_en: The lowest and highest closing prices of the past year; the marker shows where the latest price sits between them.
glossary.def_zh: 过去一年收盘价的最低与最高值；标记显示最新价格在两者之间的位置。

glossary.def_en: Cash and investments divided by the recent quarterly cash burn: roughly how long a loss-making company can fund itself without raising money.
glossary.def_zh: 现金及投资除以近期的季度现金消耗：亏损公司在不融资的情况下大约还能维持多久。

approvals.text_en: FDA approval for previously treated bile-duct cancer with an FGFR2 rearrangement; the response rate was 46%. Discovered by Relay Therapeutics, licensed to Elevar in December 2024. Relay is in the contested tier: its platform is computer simulation of protein motion, and whether that counts as AI is disputed.
approvals.text_zh: FDA 批准用于既往接受过治疗、携带 FGFR2 重排的胆管癌，客观缓解率为 46%。由 Relay Therapeutics 发现，2024 年 12 月授权给 Elevar。Relay 属于“有争议”一类：其平台是蛋白质运动的计算机模拟，是否算 AI 存在分歧。

longevity.state_en: None exists. A July 2026 Reagan-Udall / FDA meeting summary records no ageing indication, no validated ageing biomarker and no accepted endpoint.

longevity.title_en: Loyal LOY-002: a lifespan drug for senior dogs
longevity.state_en: FDA has accepted the efficacy-expectation and safety sections; the manufacturing section is outstanding. Not approved, and the STAY study has no efficacy readout yet.
longevity.state_zh: FDA 已接受“合理预期有效性”和安全性部分，生产部分尚待审评。尚未获批，STAY 研究也还没有疗效数据。
longevity.signal_en: Conditional approval, then a positive STAY lifespan readout: the first lifespan-extension approval in any species.
longevity.signal_zh: 获得有条件批准，随后 STAY 研究读出延寿阳性结果：这将是任何物种中首个延寿药物获批。

longevity.title_zh: TAME：二甲双胍对抗衰老相关疾病
longevity.state_en: Still not fully funded about a decade after it was designed; no results.
longevity.state_zh: 设计完成约十年后仍未筹足经费，没有结果。
longevity.signal_en: Full funding and first enrolment; its composite endpoint is the template for an ageing indication.
longevity.signal_zh: 经费到位并开始入组；其复合终点是衰老适应症的范本。

longevity.state_en: Twenty finalist teams named in August 2026; one-year trials run to 2029 and the prize is awarded in 2030. It measures muscle, cognition and immune function, not lifespan.
longevity.state_zh: 2026 年 8 月公布 20 支决赛队伍；为期一年的试验持续到 2029 年，2030 年颁奖。衡量的是肌肉、认知和免疫功能，而不是寿命。
longevity.signal_en: A finalist restores function by 10 years or more in a controlled trial that others replicate.
longevity.signal_zh: 某支决赛队伍在对照试验中使功能恢复 10 年以上，并被他人重复验证。

longevity.title_en: Partial reprogramming in humans (Life Biosciences ER-100)
longevity.title_zh: 人体部分重编程（Life Biosciences ER-100）
longevity.state_en: IND cleared in January 2026 and the first participant dosed in June 2026, ten years after the founding mouse paper. A safety study in eye disease only.
longevity.state_zh: 2026 年 1 月获得 IND 许可，6 月首例受试者给药，距奠基性小鼠论文已十年。目前只是眼病领域的安全性研究。
longevity.signal_en: Efficacy on vision in a controlled trial.
longevity.signal_zh: 在对照试验中显示出改善视力的疗效。

longevity.state_en: Phase 1 safety trial running since December 2025.
longevity.state_zh: 一期安全性试验自 2025 年 12 月起进行。
longevity.signal_en: A Phase 2 efficacy result in a named disease.
longevity.signal_zh: 在明确疾病中取得二期疗效结果。

longevity.title_zh: 衰老细胞清除疗法：Unity Biotechnology
longevity.state_en: UBX0101 showed no benefit over placebo in Phase 2 (2020); UBX1325 missed in Phase 2b and the company laid off all staff in May 2025.
longevity.state_zh: UBX0101 二期试验未优于安慰剂（2020 年）；UBX1325 在 2b 期未达终点，公司于 2025 年 5 月裁撤全部员工。
longevity.signal_en: A reminder: its valuation rested on mouse data. A different senolytic passing a randomised human trial would reopen the field.
longevity.signal_zh: 前车之鉴：其估值建立在小鼠数据之上。若有另一种同类疗法通过随机人体试验，这一方向才会重启。
